- Ravi’s mother wishes for a “memory‑vitamin” to help old people remember.  
- Grandpa, now living with them, has poor hearing, vision, and memory.  
- He recently had a dangerous month: took double medicine, got lost, and fell.  
- He resents moving from his quiet brick house with a mango tree to the noisy city flat.  
- Mother tells Ravi to keep Grandpa indoors and give him medicines after lunch.  
- Ravi promises to look after Grandpa while his mother goes to work.  
- Grandpa enjoys playing chess with Ravi, teaching him famous opening moves.  
- Grandpa complains about being treated like a child and wants to go out alone.  
- Ravi feels torn: mother forbids it, but Grandpa insists on freedom.  
- Ravi decides to secretly follow Grandpa at a safe distance to ensure his safety.
